scope: Read-only source and official glTF specification inspection. No actual sparse query, geometry selection, material calculation, tests, renderer, unwrap, texture or export execution.

primary_reference.title: Khronos glTF2.0 Specification source, Metallic-Roughness Material and Alpha Coverage sections
primary_reference.verified_contract: COLOR_0 is linear, interpolated and multiplies base color. Unit factors and absent texture yield the vertex-color base color. Metallic/roughness are linear factors. OPAQUE ignores alpha for opacity.

RGB_comparison_model.candidate: exact IEC_sRGB_encode(sum_i bary_i * IEC_sRGB_decode(clip(original direct-row encodedRGB_i,0,1)))
RGB_comparison_model.portable_candidate: If claimingF32COLOR_0 storage, include one F32 rounding of decoded per-vertex values and report that path. No8-bit quantization is implied.
RGB_comparison_model.metrics: RMSE over all sample×RGB components, percentile95 of absolute component errors, maximum absolute component error; each predeclared cohort independently checked at0.02/0.05/0.15.

scalar_contract.target: clip(raw genuine spatial channel,0,1), without gamma
scalar_contract.candidate_constant_definition: If following literal clip(mean(raw10000 area-weighted spatial samples),0,1), retain that exact candidate definition. It is not generally the clipped-target optimum.
scalar_contract.optimistic_per_cohort_RMSE_floor: For clipped targets y, the best legal constant under squared error is mean(y)=mean(clip(raw,0,1)); report each channel separately. This differs in general from clip(mean(raw),0,1).
scalar_contract.gates: Apply0.02RMSE per scalar channel to each declared centroid/weighted/seam cohort; record p95/max separately rather than pooling all scalar channels.
scalar_contract.alpha_limitation: Stored-alpha numerical fidelity is distinct from rendered opacity. WithOPAQUE output opacity is1, independent of learned alpha; no cutout/transparency preservation is established.

sampling_constraints: SparseSampler uses original-coordinate F32world→grid q=(world+0.5)*512, exact sparse support lookup and native-order F32 accumulation.
It interpolates original raw stored six-channel features. Do not clip or decode RGB feature values before spatial source sampling; clip only derived comparison targets afterward.
Partial support is renormalized over found rows with denominator floor1e-12; zero-support queries must fail or be explicitly blocked, never silently treated as valid black samples.
The existing seam_queries helper requires island IDs below256 and cannot directly take saved815 forest chart IDs. Seam cohorts must be explicitly declared/bounded without changing historical sources.
limitations: This is a source/metric contract only, not an actual accuracy result or execution authorization.
The exact IEC model differs from historical native renderer gamma2.2 preview; no native shaded-image equivalence is implied.
Finite surface sample success would not prove continuous-field accuracy, shading equivalence, mip behavior or exported-client behavior.
